8f2b4dd35592a675.description: About the Role: OCI & Database Platform Sales Executive Oracle is seeking a Technology Sales Executive to drive the adoption of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Database Platform (DBP) solutions within the Saudi commercial market. This full-time position is based in Jeddah or Makkah, focusing on strategic customer engagements and expanding Oracle's technology footprint. The role involves positioning integrated cloud, database, multicloud, and AI solutions to address customer business and technology transformation priorities. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans, identifying new business opportunities and driving customer acquisition and expansion. Position Oracle's cloud infrastructure, database platforms, Exadata, multicloud, AI, and modernization solutions to address enterprise business challenges. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and senior business leaders, translating technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes. Manage sales targets, generate qualified pipeline, drive competitive opportunities, and deliver predictable bookings, subscriptions, and cloud consumption growth. Develop compelling business cases, demonstrate ROI and TCO advantages, and lead complex enterprise sales cycles from qualification through negotiation and closure. Collaborate with solution engineers, cloud architects, consulting teams, customer success, and ecosystem partners to deliver integrated customer solutions. Maintain accurate forecasts, execute disciplined opportunity management, and proactively manage deal risks, stakeholder alignment, and commercial execution. Manage accounts throughout the entire sales process, from business development and prospecting to contract negotiations, signing, and post-sales support. Required Qualifications 7+ years of successful enterprise technology sales experience, preferably in cloud infrastructure, databases, enterprise software, or technology transformation. Strong understanding of cloud computing, database technologies, multicloud architectures, and enterprise IT environments. Proven track record of achieving sales targets, developing strategic accounts, and closing complex enterprise deals. Strong executive engagement, consultative selling, negotiation, and presentation skills. Experience developing account plans, managing sales pipelines, and navigating competitive sales cycles. Familiarity with the Saudi enterprise technology market and its key industries. Preferred Qualifications Experience selling Oracle OCI, Oracle Database, Exadata, or competing hyperscaler and database technologies. Understanding of enterprise cloud migration, database modernization, AI infrastructure, and consumption-based business models. Established relationships with enterprise technology decision-makers in Saudi Arabia. Success Measures Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets. Growth in OCI and DBP bookings, subscriptions, and cloud consumption. Qualified pipeline generation, conversion, and forecast accuracy. Strategic account penetration, new customer acquisition, and competitive wins. Expansion of executive relationships and customer technology adoption. About Oracle Oracle integrates data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to support industry innovations and critical services. The company embeds AI across its products and services to help customers achieve future-focused outcomes. Oracle is committed to fostering a diverse workforce and offers competitive benefits, including flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, considering all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, and protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

8f7c9c964f6a12df.description: The King Faisal Specialist Hospital - Jeddah is a 500-bed tertiary specialist hospital located in Jeddah , Saudi Arabia . It is one of the three campuses of the King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre and specializes in Oncology, Cardiac, Transplant, and Neurosciences. The Surgical Unit is a 46-bed unit, divided into two nursing stations (3 North and 3 South) under a combined nurse management and staff nursing team. A standard nurse-patient ratio is utilized for patients on 1:4 basis; however this ratio can change depending on the staffing and acuity levels of the patient in accordance with Clairvia electronic Staffer and Patient Management System. The Surgical Unit provides nursing care to adult patients (above 13-years and 11 months) requiring corrective, reconstructive or elective surgeries. Services covered on this unit are general surgical cases including Upper and Lower GI & Laparoscopic surgery, Colorectal, Ears/Nose/Throat (ENT), Plastics, Orthopedics, Vascular, Urology, Breast, Palliative and Renal Transplants. Occasionally there are admissions of off-service patients such as Medical, Gynecology, Neurology, and Cardiology patients according to specific admission criteria. Many patients admitted require complex diagnostic work-up, major surgeries, followed by a comprehensive post-operative treatment plan. Post-operatively, patients are monitored carefully and provided with appropriate medical/surgical nursing care. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Nursing (online/distance education programs cannot be considered) Current nursing (RN) license Must have a minimum of two years current experience as an RN on a surgical ward at a large tertiary-care hospital The hospital can consider only FEMALE candidates at this time. Benefits One or two-year renewable contract Tax-free income Single-status contract Accommodations provided Annual return airfare Medical coverage More than 7 calendar weeks of vacation Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree in Nursing (online/distance education programs cannot be considered) Current nursing (RN) license Must have a minimum of two years current experience as an RN on a surgical ward at a large tertiary-care hospital The hospital can consider only FEMALE candidates at this time.

Identify new customers among factories, maintenance companies and contractors. Develop customer relationships, generate RFQs and follow up on quotations to secure orders. Source products from suppliers in Saudi Arabia and overseas. Compare supplier quotations, availability, delivery times and payment terms. Prepare accurate customer quotations for management approval. Coordinate purchase orders and deliveries, and maintain records using Excel or Google Sheets. Full-time or part-time arrangements can be discussed based on experience and availability. Working hours and compensation will be agreed accordingly. Desired Candidate Profile 2–5 years of experience in industrial B2B sales, procurement or spare parts trading. Familiarity with industrial products such as bearings, mechanical seals, valves, pumps or forklift spare parts. Strong English communication and professional email writing skills; Arabic is an advantage. Good supplier sourcing, negotiation and customer follow-up skills. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Ability to check part numbers, quantities and specifications accurately. Existing relationships with industrial customers or suppliers in Saudi Arabia are an advantage. Currently based in Saudi Arabia and available to work in the Eastern Province.

8f049f8f8fa6eeae.description: About Sirar by stc Sirar by stc, established by stc, is an advanced technology and cybersecurity company. As a leading provider of cybersecurity solutions, Sirar by stc focuses on empowering organizations to manage their cyber capabilities and digital environments effectively. The company offers a comprehensive range of solutions designed to help businesses operate online safely, securely, and efficiently, providing tools to detect and prevent cybersecurity attacks and safeguard digital infrastructure. The Role of Threat Intelligence Specialist Sirar by stc is seeking a Threat Intelligence Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. The specialist will be responsible for identifying cyber threat tactics and methodologies, providing critical intelligence support, and monitoring threat activities to protect organizational objectives and resources. Key Responsibilities Identify cyber threat tactics and methodologies. Provide timely notice of imminent or hostile intentions or activities that may impact organizational objectives, resources, or capabilities. Offer current intelligence support to critical internal and external stakeholders as appropriate. Monitor and report on validated threat activities. 8f402d67ebff0dcd.description: About Pasqal Pasqal specializes in the design and development of Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) and their associated software tools. The company's technology aims to address complex use cases beyond the current capabilities of supercomputers, encompassing both industrial applications and fundamental scientific research. Pasqal's QPUs are designed for high energy efficiency, contributing to a reduction in the carbon footprint of the High-Performance Computing (HPC) industry. The Role: Senior Quantum Solutions Engineer ML Pasqal is seeking a Senior Quantum Solutions Engineer ML to join the Quantum Applications department's delivery team. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically in Thuwal or Makkah, and focuses on building and delivering client-facing solutions utilizing Pasqal’s quantum ML algorithm portfolio. The role is application-driven, involving the adaptation, integration, and deployment of existing approaches to address real-world partner and client use cases. The primary objective is to transform current methods into reliable client deliverables, with contributions to internal method improvement welcomed when they directly support project outcomes. Key Responsibilities Adapt and implement Pasqal’s existing quantum-enhanced graph ML algorithms to meet client datasets, constraints, and performance targets. Build and maintain robust ML pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, training, evaluation, and post-processing, with integration into quantum execution workflows, emulation/simulation platforms, and internal tooling. Establish baselines, metrics, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders, driving solution iterations until delivery requirements are met. Collaborate with internal R&D teams to transfer methods from research to application, clarify assumptions/limits, and select optimal approaches from the portfolio for each use case. Work with hardware and platform engineers to execute solutions on Pasqal QPUs, considering hardware and execution constraints, and reliability. Engage with domain experts from high-profile enterprises and partners to deliver solutions for real-world business problems. Produce maintainable code, documentation, and handover materials to ensure delivered solutions can be reused and supported. Maintain regular scientific and technological awareness. Qualifications and Experience Approximately 5 to 10 years of professional experience as a machine learning engineer. Demonstrated interest in quantum computing. A background in physics is considered a plus, but is not a mandatory requirement. Recruitment Process An initial 30-minute interview with the talent acquisition team. A 60-minute meeting with the team, including a technical test. An exchange with the Shaheen Engineering Manager. A final interview with Louis-Paul, the VP. An offer. Commitment to Diversity Pasqal is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. The company encourages applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of gender, ethnicity, age, religion, or sexual orientation. Joining Pasqal offers the opportunity to contribute to the rapid development of a DeepTech scale-up at the forefront of quantum technology, working alongside scientists and engineers on significant technological challenges.

8f49e12e79e614ed.description: About Soum Soum is a B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and cars across Saudi Arabia via its website and mobile app. The platform focuses on building trust for both buyers and sellers. With the recent introduction of a subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum aims to be a recommerce platform in the Kingdom. The Role of Consumer Product Manager The Consumer Product Manager is responsible for the customer experience, covering how buyers discover, evaluate, purchase, and receive used items, and how sellers list, price, and get paid. This role involves representing the Soum customer within the product team, translating consumer insights into features that enhance conversion, repeat purchases, and trust. The manager will work across app and web platforms, collaborating with design, engineering, operations, and commercial teams to implement and iterate on product features. Key Responsibilities Manage the roadmap for a core consumer area, such as the buyer journey, seller journey, or subscriptions, prioritizing based on impact on conversion, retention, GMV, and customer trust. Develop a continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets, and behavioral data. Optimize the end-to-end marketplace funnel, including listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns, and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features such as device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings, and transparent pricing. Shape subscription products for electronics and cars, focusing on value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement, and retention, in collaboration with Commercial and Finance teams. Translate problems into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria, and manage agile delivery with design and engineering teams. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localization for Saudi customers. Implement a disciplined experimentation practice, including forming hypotheses, designing A/B tests, defining success metrics, and making evidence-based decisions. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS, and customer complaints. Partner with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to ensure product changes are effective end-to-end. Monitor regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players to identify and adapt best practices for Soum's customers. Qualifications and Requirements 2–4 years of product management experience with consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech, or consumer apps. Proven track record of delivering consumer features that have demonstrably impacted business metrics. Strong consumer intuition supported by data, with proficiency in product analytics tools (*, Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis, and A/B testing; working knowledge of SQL is an advantage. Hands-on experience developing for mobile (iOS and Android) and web platforms. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust, and pricing. Experience collaborating with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specifications and prioritization skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, capable of aligning operations, commercial, and technical teams. A proactive approach, demonstrating the ability to make decisions with incomplete information and prioritize outcomes over output. Preferred Qualifications Experience with KSA or GCC consumers, Arabic/RTL products, and local payment methods. Background in used goods, recommerce, automotive, or subscription businesses. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

8fe08808d07cc9c0.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات عن مشغل محطة تحلية مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة وصيانة أنظمة وآلات التحكم لضمان كفاءة إنتاج المياه المحلاة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل أنظمة التحكم بتحلية المياه، والعمل على إزالة الأملاح والمعادن لإنتاج المياه العذبة. مراقبة عمليات وأنظمة التحكم، وضمان بقاء جودة وحجم إمدادات المياه ضمن الحدود المحددة مسبقاً، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية عند الضرورة. القيام بعمليات فحص روتينية خاصة بأعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الأساسية للأجزاء المعطلة أو المتضررة، وإعداد تقارير بالأعطال لفنيي أو تقنيي الصيانة، واختبار المعدات بعد إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تشغيل محطات تحلية المياه أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لأنظمة التحكم في تحلية المياه وعملياتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الأساسية وتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل تتطلب هذه الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في محطة تحلية المياه بالجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المشغل ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة عمليات المحطة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

8feff1de3c011190.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مباني الجزيرة العربية للمشاريع عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير الدعم الإداري الأساسي وضمان تجربة استقبال احترافية للزوار والعملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إعلام الموظفين المعنيين بوجود المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى الجهة المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية عالية. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهية وكتابية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن بيئة احترافية تتطلب الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

8fa5eb50078f5995.description: MEP Manager Dammam, Saudi Arabia Accommodation, car, insurance, visa and flight costs covered by client Role overview: Overall Responsibility for all site MEP technical and engineering aspects of their assigned project in conjunction with subordinate discipline Project Engineers and BIM / Design Team leads. This includes engineering review of handover from the Tender Team, planning, executing and management of all the technical tasks to assure accuracy, proper resources, and quality from start to finish of the assigned project. MEP Managers are the primary link between Engineering site team and BIM / Design team to the Project Manager; Construction Managers and Client Engineering Team Leads Responsibilities of an MEP Manager: Assist the Pre- Construction Manager and Estimating Team to ensure robust tendering. Critique tender documentation / Pre-Construction project handover documentation, identify project risks and constructability studies with BIM Team. Conduct design reviews to ensure all engineering parameters, calculations, etc. are in line with project requirements and local and mandatory codes. Overall Management and coordination of RIBA stage drawings (if design and build), discipline shop drawings and as built drawings process to Code A status (in coordination with BIM Lead and MEP Discipline Engineers) Prepare design / engineering programmed in conjunction with the Project Manager, Project Controls Engineer, Client Consultants and Specialist contractors in line with overall project delivery schedule. Provide day-to-day links with client consultants and engineering discipline team. Develops and maintains a comprehensive Project Engineering Plan, in keeping with the size and complexity as mutually agreed upon by the JEG organization SOP and the Project Manager. Preparation of sub-contractor Scope of Works documentation in coordination with Project Manager to ensure all scope is captured including detailed attendances to mitigate risk of scope gaps in agreements. Establish Project client consultant and overall engineering deliverable requirements. Day to day management of the Discipline Project Engineers. Ensure all construction design / execution issues are addressed in coordination with the discipline project engineers and site stakeholders. Provide input to Project Change Management process via QS and Project Manager Provide input to the Risks and Opportunities Register. Manage, Review / prepare engineering studies as applicable and coordinate / review third-party studies as applicable. Manage coordination with BIM Team, discipline engineers and validation of material take-offs for all disciplines. Manage coordination with Construction Team and validate material take-off top-ups for all disciplines with subordinate Project Engineers and BIM Lead. Manage coordination via Discipline Engineers of all specialist plant suppliers and specialist systems suppliers to ensure suitable interfaces are achieved e.g., specification design compliance (providing design input as required), correct supplies to equipment and third-party interface, BMS, etc. Oversee coordination of all MEP services via Construction and BIM Lead for clash mitigation. Manage, liaise and coordinate the builders’ work requirements with Construction Managers / BIM Team. Management and coordinate preparation of engineering and material submittals with subordinate Discipline Engineers to Code A status. Assist, verification and inspection of systems in line with approved submittals and design (assistance to QA/QC, Construction and Commissioning via discipline leads) Provide technical support in coordination with subordinate Discipline Engineers to Construction Managers as required to ensure the installation meets the design, including regular site work front inspections with construction leads as required. Study the project specifications in detail and be aware of the scope of work. Be able to identify variations and officially track through the RFI process. Manage preparation, coordination of MR’s / RFQs for the Procurement department to issue to vendors as pertaining to engineered equipment. Arrange and attend weekly meetings as required and arrange Minutes of meetings for records. Coordinate with Project Controls Engineer for weekly Progress Report development Liaise with the commercial team in providing technical information and back-up on variations. Monitor progress and status of RFI's and document control in coordination with Project Controls Lead. Management of red-line drawings and As-built drawings in coordination with BIM Lead, Construction teams and QA/QC teams. Management of the MEP systems O&Ms to Code A status Management and coordination with Commissioning team for client training requirements. Escalate to Project Manager any engineering issues arising that may affect project schedule or project execution plans. Supervise, develop and mentor project staff. Ensuring that the HSE requirements are observed in the execution of all engineering activities. Provide regular input to the continuous improvement log (lessons learned), implementing changes where deficiencies are identified and corrective actions proposed. Ensure awareness and compliance of the QSP’s which are located and maintained in the JEG Group Quality Library. Provides a working environment that develops a highly productive, adaptive, motivated and creative team which builds cooperation, respect, Team and Self focus, openness, respect and commitment

8fba257d5f3e7f81.description: Job description Join Us At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact. What you’ll do Role Purpose: Defined the criteria/KPIs to assess mobile network performance from end-user / service perspective and monitor on daily basis service performance Responsible for mobile quality framework management. Preparation of executive network performance analysis and dashboards on periodical bases. Ensure implementation & harmonization of mobile performance indicators with vertical organization. Highlight improvements/ degradation and provide detailed root cause analysis. Create insights and competitive analysis based on mobile crowd sourcing solutions. Responsibilities Lead mechanical package engineering activities across PDP and FEED stages, including design development, proposal preparation, and delivery of engineering deliverables for major projects. Review and approve mechanical package designs, specifications, and engineering outputs, ensuring compliance with international codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. Provide technical support across project phases, including resolving design and operational issues, engaging with vendors/clients, and supporting procurement activities. Develop, maintain, and govern mechanical package standards while mentoring junior engineers and supporting project planning, scheduling, and performance tracking. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 15 years’ experience in petrochemical, refining, oil & gas, or related industries, including significant FEED/EPC exposure. Strong knowledge of international codes and regulations (API, ASME, ISO, PIP, NFPA, IEC, HCIS, RCER) with the ability to interpret specifications and evaluate technical deviations. Proven expertise in engineering tools (e.g., PV Elite, COMPRESS), mechanical package deliverables, vendor coordination, and technical problem‑solving within complex project environments. We appreciate the interest of all applicants. However, only those who meet the specified criteria will be contacted. Thank you. Thank you.

A simple smile in the lobby can create the positivity that turns a business trip into a new business celebration. An insider tip on the best way to spend a day can make an entire holiday. A romantic dinner for two can lead to a longer term partnership. It doesn’t take much to make a moment. Just to be genuine. And human. And warm. Strong fluency in English is required; fluency in Arabic and/or French is highly advantageous. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

8fc05877fa0ffbd6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مكون للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية من مرحلة الدراسة الأولية وحتى التنفيذ، مع ضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية أو الإشراف على المشاريع. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني في شركة مكون للمقاولات ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، حيث يساهم في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام الموكلة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقدم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

8fdb675a8388d9cb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الموافي للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة، حيث سيتولى المهندس مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى صيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تحديد مسارات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وإعداد مخططاتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال في الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ إجراءات الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة الموافي للمقاولات العامة في مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام المشروع والصيانة الدورية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا في مكة المكرمة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

8fe5a551c7ad7b97.description: About flyakeed flyakeed is a Saudi-based online travel platform established in 2017 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The platform specializes in simplifying flight and hotel bookings and provides integrated travel solutions, with a focus on business and corporate travel. flyakeed is supported by investors including Sanabil Investments, Elm, Artal Capital, and Alrajhi Partners. About the Travel Ambassador Role flyakeed is offering an Entry-Level Employment opportunity for a Travel Ambassador as part of its Wa’ed Program. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who have a strong interest in travel, customer service, and corporate travel, and are looking to build a long-term career in the travel industry. Key Responsibilities Create and manage travel itineraries based on traveler preferences, company policies, and budget requirements. Assist with booking flights, hotels, car rentals, and other travel-related services. Learn and utilize Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and other travel booking platforms and industry tools. Provide professional, personalized, and high-quality customer service to corporate and VVIP travelers. Serve as a point of contact for assigned customers and assist with their travel-related requests. Communicate with travelers through phone, email, and other communication channels in a professional and timely manner. Monitor bookings and ensure all travel arrangements are accurate and aligned with company policies and approved travel guidelines. Assist travelers with changes, cancellations, delays, and other travel-related issues while minimizing disruption. Anticipate customer needs and recommend appropriate travel solutions to enhance the overall travel experience. Coordinate with airlines, hotels, car rental companies, and other travel service providers when required. Maintain accurate records of bookings, transactions, and customer communications. Handle customer information and travel details with a high level of confidentiality and professionalism. Develop knowledge of flyakeed’s services, values, and unique offerings and represent the company professionally. Stay informed about travel destinations, travel requirements, regulations, and industry trends. Collaborate with team members to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction and service quality. Continuously develop knowledge and skills in corporate travel, customer service, and travel management. Professional Development The successful candidate will receive on-the-job exposure and development opportunities in areas such as travel booking, corporate travel management, customer service, and VVIP traveler support. Application Process This position offers an opportunity for Saudi talent at the beginning of their professional careers to join flyakeed.

8fc92e5dffb2a3a7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إمكان الطبية عن أخصائي مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تقييم احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية من المواد، والبحث في السوق للحصول على أفضل عروض الشراء، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عملية استلام وتقييم عروض الموردين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم احتياجات ومتطلبات مختلف الوحدات التنظيمية من المواد المختلفة وتحديد أولويات الشراء بناءً على ذلك. إجراء الدراسات والتحليلات المتخصصة ومسح السوق بهدف الوصول لأفضل أسعار شراء من الموردين ولتأمين الجودة المطلوبة للمواد وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. الإشراف على عمليات وإجراءات استلام العروض من موردي الخدمات وتقييمها بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الإدارية الأخرى وضمان مطابقتها للإجراءات المعتمدة في الإدارة. بناء قاعدة بيانات لأسعار المواد التي يتم استهلاكها بصورة متكررة وأهم الموردين لها والاحتفاظ بملفات متكاملة عن عمليات الشراء المختلفة وفقاً للنظام المعتمد. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة بالمبيعات وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة والحلول الملائمة وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المشتريات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات وتحديد أولويات الشراء. مهارات قوية في التفاوض والبحث عن أفضل الأسعار والجودة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة قواعد البيانات الخاصة بالموردين والأسعار. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية ممتازة لتقييم العروض والأسعار. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق فعالة مع الوحدات الداخلية والموردين. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في عمليات الشراء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي المشتريات ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

8f7a82016d99be59.description: About the Role Munshi HR Solutions Ltd is seeking a Poultry Veterinarian for a contract position in Saudi Arabia. This role is central to ensuring the health and welfare of poultry birds through diligent monitoring, disease diagnosis, and the implementation of preventative health measures. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Poultry Veterinarian will be responsible for overseeing the comprehensive health management of poultry flocks. This includes proactive health monitoring, accurate diagnosis and treatment of diseases, and the development and execution of effective health programs. The role requires close collaboration with various farm teams to uphold biosecurity standards and optimize flock performance. Key Responsibilities Monitor the overall health and welfare of poultry birds. Diagnose and treat poultry diseases and health problems. Conduct regular flock health checks and clinical examinations. Develop and implement vaccination and medication programs. Monitor vaccination effectiveness and maintain proper records. Advise farm teams on biosecurity and disease prevention measures. Conduct post-mortem examinations and identify causes of mortality. Monitor feed, water quality, and flock performance from a veterinary perspective. Coordinate with farm, hatchery, feed, and production teams on health-related issues. Maintain veterinary records and prepare regular reports on flock health and disease status. Experience and Work Type Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in poultry veterinary medicine. This is a contract position, offering an opportunity to contribute significantly to poultry health management within a professional environment. Location This role is based in Saudi Arabia, providing an opportunity to work within the region's agricultural sector. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed to qualified candidates.

8fe2bd8edc19b56e.description: About Blooming Wear Blooming Wear is a Saudi brand focused on providing women with comfortable and confidence-boosting apparel for various stages of life. The company emphasizes thoughtful design, quality, and care to meet daily needs in a respectful and empowering manner. Inspired by the butterfly, the brand's identity reflects softness, transformation, and elegance. The Role of Financial Business Analyst Blooming Wear is seeking a Financial Business Analyst to join its team in Makkah, covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for independently preparing, analyzing, and improving management reporting across the Group and its business units. The analyst will manage monthly P&L reporting, support budgeting and forecasting, conduct performance analysis, and prepare management presentations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Prepare accurate monthly P&L reports for assigned companies, channels, and business units within agreed timelines. Reconcile management reports to the general ledger and investigate material differences with Accounting. Support annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and scenario models in coordination with business owners. Analyze revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, net profit, margins, expenses, and key operational drivers. Assess profitability by company, channel, customer, category, product, store, project, or other relevant dimension. Analyze inventory, receivables, payables, and cash conversion drivers, highlighting emerging risks. Validate source data and reconcile information across ERP, sales, inventory, courier, and other operating systems. Automate recurring reports and analysis using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and other approved tools. Maintain clear review checks, documentation, and audit trails for financial models and management reports. Identify reporting gaps, inefficient processes, and control weaknesses, proposing practical improvements. Financial Planning and Analysis The Financial Business Analyst will review and challenge assumptions for sales, gross margin, operating expenses, working capital, and cash flow. This includes tracking actual performance against budget, forecast, and prior year, and providing reliable outlook updates. The role also involves building sensitivity and what-if analyses to support commercial and operational decisions. Data Management and Automation A key aspect of this role involves converting financial and operational data into clear business insights, challenging results where necessary, and improving recurring reports through standardization and automation. The analyst will support the integration of Dynamics 365 data into dashboards and standardized management reports, and use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate analysis and presentation preparation. Cross-Functional Coordination and Continuous Improvement The analyst will work closely with Accounting to ensure transactions are complete and correctly classified for management reporting. This role requires partnering with Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain, IT, and subsidiary teams to understand performance drivers and following up independently on missing inputs and unresolved variances. The analyst will also support ad-hoc financial analysis and strategic projects assigned by the Finance Manager.

8f0987e0d18e4edb.description: About the Role Mitsubishi Electric Saudi Ltd. is seeking an Information Technology Specialist to manage regional IT requirements in Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves configuring, installing, and maintaining IT components, supporting network and hardware administration, and resolving IT support issues. Key Responsibilities Install new software and hardware components. Regularly evaluate IT systems to ensure they meet necessary demands. Assist with network administration tasks. Ensure data storage is safe and secure. Resolve IT system and software issues for coworkers. Educate coworkers on network security and best practices for computer usage. Support the day-to-day operations of the computer network. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in a relevant IT role, with a range of 2-5 years preferred. Fluency in English, both spoken and written. This position is open to Saudi nationals only. Location This role is based in Medina (المدينة المنورة), Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

8f05f43bf2ba5bb3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصانع الخليج العربى للصناعات البلاستيكية والمطاطية عن مدير تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة وتنفيذ الاستراتيجية التسويقية للشركة، مع التركيز على تعزيز العلامة التجارية وزيادة الحصة السوقية. يتضمن الدور إدارة الحملات التسويقية، دراسة السوق والمنافسين، وإطلاق المنتجات الجديدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنفيذ الاستراتيجية والخطة التسويقية السنوية بما يتوافق مع أهداف الشركة. المشاركة في تطوير المنتجات الجديدة بدءًا من مرحلة الفكرة ودراسة احتياجات السوق وصولاً إلى الإطلاق والمتابعة. إعداد وتنفيذ خطط التسويق التجاري (Trade Marketing) بالتعاون مع أقسام المبيعات وقنوات التوزيع. إعداد وإدارة الميزانية التسويقية، ومتابعة المصروفات، وقياس العائد على الأنشطة والحملات التسويقية. وضع جداول زمنية واضحة للمشاريع التسويقية، وتحديد مراحل التنفيذ ومواعيد الإنجاز، ومتابعتها. تطوير وإدارة العلامة التجارية وتعزيز حضورها في السوق. دراسة السوق السعودي، والمنافسين، وتوجهات العملاء، والفرص التسويقية المتاحة. تخطيط وتنفيذ الحملات الإعلانية والترويجية وقياس فعاليتها. التعامل والتنسيق مع وكالات الدعاية والإعلان والتسويق ومتابعة جودة التنفيذ. إعداد خطط إطلاق المنتجات الجديدة (Go-to-Market) ومتابعة أدائها بعد الإطلاق. التعاون مع أقسام المبيعات والإدارات ذات العلاقة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التجارية والتسويقية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال التسويق. يُفضل وجود خبرة سابقة في قطاع السلع الاستهلاكية سريعة التداول (FMCG). معرفة قوية بالسوق السعودي. خبرة في إدارة العلامات التجارية والتسويق الاستراتيجي. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية والتجارية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

8f0f23e6d989c055.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Director of Nursery Operations for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery for Red Sea Global's destinations. Botanica integrates new species with local flora, operating across 1 million square meters with a focus on sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala. This full-time position is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Director of Nursery Operations will lead the operational functions of the 180-hectare Botanica site. This includes overseeing field operations, plant maintenance, plant protection, irrigation and water management (2,000–4,000 m3 per day), soil mix and growing media production, logistics, receiving and dispatch, and facilities, fleet, and workshop management. The primary objective is to ensure plant health, timely and complete order fulfillment, and safe and efficient site operations for all business units. Key Responsibilities Manage and organize all nursery areas, including planting zones (1,533,100 m2), shading (173,800 m2), and mother stock areas. Oversee routine maintenance of nursery stock, including weeding, pruning, spacing, cleaning, and daily plant health monitoring. Implement plant protection measures in accordance with the IPM and biosecurity program. Design, operate, and maintain the irrigation network and pump stations, setting schedules by zone and season. Monitor water quality, flow, and consumption, focusing on reducing freshwater use through TSE, drip, and smart irrigation. Develop and maintain contingency plans for water supply interruptions and system failures. Source raw materials and produce consistent soil mixes and substrates to approved recipes, supplying internal sections and external clients. Manage receiving of local and imported plants and materials, coordinating with Biosecurity for inspection and quarantine. Plan and execute dispatch against confirmed orders, including picking, loading, transport, and delivery documentation. Coordinate imports through the bonded facility and maintain accurate stock movement records. Implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for facilities, greenhouses, shade structures, and equipment. Manage fleet availability, utilization, and compliance, overseeing workshops and the asset register. Manage the Nursery Operations budget, including labor, water, energy, fuel, spares, and maintenance. Allocate manpower, machinery, and transport across sections, supporting Production and Landscape Maintenance requests. Report monthly KPIs and identify operational risks with corrective actions. Lead section heads, supervisors, and operatives, setting competency and training standards. Control high-risk activities in collaboration with HSSE, including machinery, chemicals, lifting, driving, and heat stress. Fulfill the responsibilities of a Department Head as outlined in Section ** Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Champion the safety, quality, and environmental management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and client value. Work Environment and Context Nursery Operations supports all Botanica business units, including Production, Landscape Maintenance, and Commercial. The role is critical, as operational failures, such as irrigation outages during peak heat or equipment breakdowns, can lead to significant losses and project delays. This position requires a proactive approach focused on prevention and redundancy to mitigate risks effectively. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in nursery operations or a related field. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing large-scale operations and teams. Strong understanding of sustainable practices in horticulture and nursery management. Experience with irrigation systems, water management, and soil science. Proficiency in budget management, resource allocation, and performance reporting. Knowledge of HSSE standards and compliance management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 37301).

8fdf1c92545c58ac.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أرتيري عن أخصائي مبيعات مستلزمات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات للمستلزمات الطبية، وإدارة علاقات العملاء، وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق، وتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية. اقتراح سياسات البيع، ومتابعة تنفيذ السياسات والطرق البيعية، ووضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل مع العملاء لتحديد احتياجاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع، وتقييم مدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. إدارة العملاء والمبيعات بناء قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين مع بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. الاتصال بالعملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وتقديم عروض البيع، واستعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفاتورة وتحصيل المبلغ. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها وتوريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مبيعات المستلزمات الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. مهارات قوية في جمع البيانات وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة في سوق المستلزمات الطبية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة أرتيري، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.
